title: Edgar Mitchell speaks out on UFOs

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to Edgar Mitchell, an astronaut on Apollo 14, the 1971 NASA mission to the Moon, as someone who ended up speaking out on UFOs in the years that followed. Michels offers him as an example of a credible insider who went public, which, if his claims hold, would lend weight to the subject.
